annotations.title: Generate FAR 42.1503 CPARS Self-Assessment & 14-Day Reviewing Official Rebuttal

description: Transform contract performance metrics (SLA attainment, CDRL on-time delivery, cost variance, key personnel stability, small business utilization) and Assessing Official (AO) draft CPAR narratives into a FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 justified CPARS Self-Assessment Package, factor-by-factor rating upgrade narratives (Quality, Schedule, Cost Control, Management, Small Business), a formal 14-Calendar-Day Reviewing Official (RO) Rebuttal Brief correcting factual omissions and excusable Government GFE delays, and a COR Evidence Binder checklist. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive post-award past-performance generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `contract_metrics_and_assessing_official_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `cpar_submission_mode` and `target_far_42_1503_rating_goal` calibrate proactive annual self-assessments vs. 14-day non-concurrence rebuttals under FAR 42.1503(d)). Use this tool when preparing an annual CPARS Self-Assessment for the COR/Assessing Official or rebutting an unfavorable draft CPAR within the statutory 14-calendar-day window; use `generate_cpars_past_performance` instead when formatting already-completed historical contracts into a Proposal Volume III Past Performance submission, or `analyze_debriefing_bid_protest` for FAR 15.506 post-award debriefings and GAO bid protests.

contract_metrics_and_assessing_official_.description: Contract performance metrics (SLA attainment, CDRL on-time delivery, cost variance, key personnel fill rate, small business goals) and, if rebutting a draft CPAR, the Assessing Official's draft ratings and narrative (20 to 45,000 characters).

cpar_submission_mode.description: Submission mode under FAR 42.1503: Proactive Annual Self-Assessment Package, 14-Calendar-Day Draft CPAR Rebuttal to Reviewing Official, or Both (defaults to 'Proactive_Annual_CPARS_Self_Assessment_And_14_Day_Rebuttal_Package').

target_far_42_1503_rating_goal.description: Target FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 rating outcome across Quality, Schedule, Cost Control, Management, Small Business, and Regulatory Compliance (defaults to 'Upgrade_To_Exceptional_And_Very_Good_With_Positive_Rec').

name: generate_post_award_cpar_rebuttal

cor_evidence_binder_checklist.description: Checklist of objective artifacts (CDRL acceptance receipts, monthly IPR slides, WAWF vouchers, eSRS confirmations, COR emails) to attach to the CPARS submission.

cpar_evaluation_overview.description: High-level FAR 42.1503 CPARS assessment, 14-day deadline rule, and rating upgrade feasibility.

far_42_1503_factor_by_factor_narratives.description: Factor-by-factor CPARS narratives mapped to FAR 42.1503 Table 42-1 across Quality, Schedule, Cost Control, Management, and Small Business.

fourteen_day_reviewing_official_rebuttal.description: Formal 14-Calendar-Day Reviewing Official rebuttal brief correcting factual errors and excusable Government delays.

title: Generate FAR 42.1503 CPARS Self-Assessment & 14-Day Reviewing Official Rebuttal
